training_map.selection: One new training map cleared both by seed and board hash. Preassigned two seats. Enter at step 240 unconditionally if the original game is active; retain extinction, losing roll-ins, equal actions and adverse or identical continuations. No seed replacement. Neither independent development nor the formal exam.

teacher.role: Apex V1 is derived from the original examiner family. It alone issues the friendly team's physical orders for steps 0 through 239. Its wealth, scores or wins do not establish student performance.

original.role: Exact bytes of sources/master3s2/master3s2.py. Public native agent from step 0 to each official terminal, natural RNG, temperature 1 and original 0.58 s adaptive wall clock. No substituted or scaled search.

student.role: Persistent public calls on the actual training prefix for feature/history warm-up only. All physical orders from step 240 on come from this exact deployed Sapling package, with its 252 and 276 natural stochastic decision points when feasible.

execution: One live parent per seat, sequential seats. Sequential actor requests on dedicated available logical CPU 0 for teacher/student and 1 for original, single BLAS/OpenMP thread. Separate timing for actual and shadow calls, all step 0 and active/finished orders logged. Runtime is a local training diagnostic. This is not a competition timing certificate. Verify a warmed, disposable non-registered fixture fork is responsive before starting. Acquire an exclusive start marker per map/seat. Each source prefix and original natural draw is generated once.
fork: At t240 before either actor sees that observation, hold the unmodified living official environment and the living original and Sapling processes' Python state in the same one-thread OS parent. Fork each continuation from this exact parent; run serially on identical affinities. Verify the same prefix byte hash, game board/ID counters, remaining clocks and signed public observations, original tracker and prior players, 4 wall-cost calibration fields, source RandomState and search telemetry, and student observation history at child entry. For the student only, reset the sampling-generator handle to None in each child so its published original public entry draws a fresh OS seed; retain its physical model/history. Compare entropy fingerprints but never choose on draws. The original continues the same exact RNG state in both children; distinct histories and measured wall search can diverge. These are conditionally paired actor continuations with common examiner randomness at the cut, not two independent trajectories from the initial board.
fallback: If the pre-run fork mechanism check fails, conduct a single continuous official continuation for each seat through the live parent. If the first child hangs or fails before delivering a complete genuine suffix, retain that attempt and play one uninterrupted suffix from the untouched before-split parent, with no resampled roll-in. If child A completed and child B fails, retain A and the failure and do not replace B. No retries of a registered source root or result-based branching. If both workers or scores are unavailable, quarantine and report; preserve every attempted action.
report: One receipt per seat with pre-switch cash/cargo/tree/workers and teacher order/shadow Sapling disagreement. For every complete appendix report raw official terminal rewards, focal margin, W/D/L, U=0.5*WDL+0.5*sigmoid(margin/1000), suffix orders with material two-order support, CPU and wall-time, original positive/zero depth and failures. Keep exact copied examiner state evidence and every loss/timeout. A live teacher prefix or one map cannot yield a student full-game win, win-rate estimate, or eligible formal exam score. No policy learning on incomplete/quarantined evidence. If available, both suffixes and their pairing are training records. Training weight changes and formal/fresh games lie outside this experiment.
